question: does a gate that keeps only capacity and copy reach parity with no gate on the 22-face task, after growing the store instead of refusing?
sequence: phase 0 baseline geometry (read only, no verdict)
this manifest is written and hashed
arm U: no gate at all (ceiling)
arm S: simplified gate, capacity + copy only, growth before refusal

mapping.task_shape: package 20: 22 correction surfaces per world on a content-addressed store that starts at 32 slots (living_core.ADDRESSED_SLOTS) and may grow
mapping.store: existing F1/F3 fixture unchanged: same encoder (localized_centered, legacy centroid), 128-d keys, 8192-d values, ADDRESSED_TEMPERATURE 0.1
mapping.why_not_the_model: the gate is a numpy store check; inserting it into the torch graph would change the frozen read path. This probe measures it where it acts, on store writes
mapping.face_definition: face i writes a correction whose value token is the i-th new token at position 5, and is read with the same token at a different position; a face is correct iff the read's top-1 slot is the slot it was written to
mapping.no_eviction: append only; a full store is refused, never evicted

growth_protocol.trigger: growth_runtime.write_headroom(...).sufficient is false for the next write
growth_protocol.recheck: the reserve is re-checked on the grown store before the write
growth_protocol.on_failure: refuse with commit_rejected_no_capacity, roll back bit-identically

criteria.S1_corrections: the simplified gate must reach 22/22: face i writes its correction at position 5 and is read with the same token at another position; correct iff the final store's top-1 slot for that read is the slot the face was written to
criteria.S2_retention: the 7 held-out exact keys of the 8-row baseline must still read back to their own slots; integer count out of 7
criteria.S3_no_loss: no eviction and no dropped write may occur; either one fails the run
criteria.S4_failure_attribution: if a face is not correct, it is classified as refused (owns no slot), written_but_read_wrong (its slot still holds its value but the synonym reads another slot) or slot_value_corrupted (its own slot no longer holds its value)
criteria.S5_ceiling: the same 22 faces are appended with no gate and no refusal; that reading is the ceiling, and the simplified gate's loss is reported face by face with its cause
criteria.S6_growth: before any capacity refusal the store doubles per growth_runtime.plan_growth and the reserve h >= 0.125 is re-checked on the grown store; a failed growth is the only capacity refusal and it rolls back bit-identically without evicting
criteria.S7_collapse_line: if the post-growth read margin falls below 0.02 it is recorded and marked as not used by the verdict; the capacity/precision trade-off is the owner's call
criteria.judge_rule: 22/22 + 7/7 + 0 evictions + 0 dropped -> simplified_holds_at_parity; corrections < 22 -> simplified_below_parity with per-face causes; any eviction or dropped write -> simplified_failed
criteria.no_soft_language: a face that the gate loses is reported as lost, never as 'close'; a run with no refusals may not be described as evidence that refusals are safe
criteria.unchanged: no threshold, fixture, face or battery is retuned after the first reading

retention_caveat: the 7/7 battery is exact stored keys, so an append can never lower it (a key's cosine to its own slot is 1.0). It is reported as the registered convention; the paraphrase retention is a labelled diagnostic and is not used by the verdict
